youtube.title: Tip: put a wide screen recording in a vertical Short with one push-in line
youtube.description:
Tip: a wide screen recording in a vertical Short.
Push in on the part that matters with one shot-list line, "type": "frame". Framing only crops and scales: it never changes what was recorded.
This Short rendered in under 50 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU. Made with funkbox.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
